title: GameChainConfig
description: Heterogeneous game-chain — ONE lesson that plays an ORDERED sequence of whole sub-game rounds (e.g. drag-sort → label-diagram → memory-pairs) as a single scored session. Rounds always run in array order (simple → complex, never shuffled). Each round carries its own template + full sub-game config; rounds may not nest game-chain (no recursion) and puzzle-split is excluded (its difficulty-ladder scoring does not fit a linear chain).

characters.description: Recurring host character(s) shown between rounds.

rounds.description: Ordered heterogeneous rounds — each is a WHOLE sub-game. Renderers MUST play them in array order; the order is the pedagogy.

label.description: Short round name shown in the progress strip, e.g. 'Sort the shapes', 'Label the face'

template.description: Sub-game template for this round. game-chain (no nesting) and puzzle-split (difficulty-ladder scoring) are excluded.

config.description: Full sub-game config for `template` (must itself carry template/lessonId/ageLevel/category/tier/item_id + the template's content collections). Validated against that template's rules at save time.

promptMode.description: Overall presentation hint; each round keeps its own modes.
